description: What a consumer of the TURN relay learns from coturn, stamped into the consumer's deployed config by this service so the consumer's own .nix can read it declaratively from its companion JSON.
_note: Provider-writes-consumer-FACTS, not consumer config: coturn's install/update-service derive turnHost from coturn's own publicDomain (else its internal FQDN) and write it to /home/tappaas/config/<consumer>.json. The consumer never authors it, and the merge keeps a deployed-only field. The shared secret is NOT a field — it stays in the management plane (/home/tappaas/secrets/coturn.env).

turnHost.description: host:port of the TURN/STUN relay this consumer advertises to its clients (Nextcloud Talk, the HPB's turn.servers, Janus's own ICE). Derived by coturn:turn: <publicDomain>:3478 when coturn declares a publicDomain — the same name in every horizon, split-horizon DNS resolving it to the coturn VM inside the site — else <vmname>.<zone0>.internal:3478, which only in-network clients can resolve.
turnHost.default: <derived: coturn publicDomain or internal FQDN, port 3478>
turnHost.note: Stamped, never authored. Re-derived on every update of the consumer, so a coturn publicDomain change propagates on the next sweep.
turnHost.changeNote: A fact about the provider, refreshed on every converge; changing it re-points TURN in Talk and the HPB without touching any guest disk.
